references.text: Lot's prayer for a small city as a refuge foreshadows and illuminates the concept of cities of refuge in Deuteronomy.
Both verses illustrate the desperate logic of fleeing to an uncertain refuge to avoid certain death.
Contrast between human refuge (the city) and divine refuge (God), highlighting the need for true protection.
Parallel between Cain's fate as a fugitive and Lot's desperate plea to become a refugee to save his life.
Lot's prayer for a small city as a refuge is a narrative precursor to the law of cities of refuge in Deuteronomy 5.
Contrast between human refuge (the city) and divine refuge (the Lord) on the day of distress.
